summary: M0 model-only verdict: ESCALATE @ 1.00. Ten consecutive successful logins from Lisbon, Portugal over university VPN (vpn-edge-02) from a single device (LT-3104) are consistent with a faculty member travelling abroad. However, one earlier sign-in (2026-10-15 06:40 UTC) from Manisa, Turkey (Turkcell, no VPN, no device_id, mail app) occurs just 32 minutes before the first Lisbon login — impossible travel between Turkey and Portugal. The anomalous event lacks a device_id and bypasses the VPN, and MFA prompt count is 0 across all events, so the signal is not explained. There is no confirmed takeover (no failed auth, no MFA fatigue, no mail rules), but the impossible-travel + missing device identity is insufficient to clear as benign and too serious to treat as mere monitoring without verification. Human review (contact the faculty, confirm travel/device) is required before any containment action that could disrupt a legitimate traveller.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
